rules.introP1: Predicto is a prediction game for the 2026 Football Tournament. The goal is to predict all types of results - from match scores, through bonus predictions like top scorer, all the way to predicting the full route from the group stage to the champion!
rules.introP2: The game has two modes to compete in - **Classic Mode** for anyone looking for simple predictions, and **Multi Mode** for the true experts.
rules.classicIntroP1: In this mode there are two types of predictions to make:
rules.classicMatchP1:
The goal is to predict the exact result for every match (results refer to 90 minutes, not including extra time or penalties).

Points can be earned for:
Direction - the correct winner/draw
Exact score

Predictions lock the moment the match starts.
rules.classicBonusP1: 12 questions for the group stage, knockout stage, and the full tournament.
rules.classicBonusNoteBasic: Basic league type counts only the 3 tournament questions toward your score.
rules.classicBonusNoteLock: All bonus questions lock when the tournament begins. Make sure you've predicted everything before the tournament starts.
rules.multiP1:
Multi Mode includes all Classic Mode predictions, plus route predictions — covering the full path from the group stage all the way to the Final.

The route predictions are structured as follows:
rules.multiGroupP1:
The goal is to predict the exact finishing positions (1–4) for all 4 teams in each of the 12 groups.

Note — group predictions can be edited until the end of Matchday 2!

Points are awarded per correct position as follows:
rules.multi3rdSubtitle: The goal is to correctly predict which 8 of the 12 groups will have their 3rd-place team advance to the knockout stage.
rules.multi3rdEditWindow: Note — 3rd place predictions can be edited until the end of Matchday 2!
rules.multi3rdScoringNote:
Points are awarded based on correctly predicting the exact group whose 3rd-place team advanced — regardless of which team it was.

Points are awarded as follows:
rules.multi3rdNote: You pick 8 of 12 — at least 4 are always correct. Points kick in from 5 correct.
rules.multiKnockoutP1:
The goal is to predict the winner of every knockout match — from the Last 32 all the way to the Final.

Predictions will be available up to the Semi-Final stage (see the Prediction Windows section for full details).
rules.multiKnockoutNoteGreen: ✅ Full points — your predicted winner won this exact match.
rules.multiKnockoutNoteYellow:
🟡 Partial points — your predicted winner advanced, but through a different match in the same round.

Example: you predicted France to win in match 90 in the Round of 16, but France won in match 95 in the Round of 16. In this case, partial points are awarded for the Round of 16 stage - 4 points.
rules.multiFinesIntro: Changes can be made to route predictions in Multi Mode.
rules.multiFinesChangesP1: Each of the following counts as one change:
rules.multiFinesChangesBullet1: Group Stage — each team that changed position within places 1–3 in a group (changes to 4th place do not count).
rules.multiFinesChangesBullet2: 3rd Place — each group added or removed from your selection.
rules.multiFinesChangesBullet3: Knockout — changing the predicted winner of any match.
rules.multiFreeP1: As the tournament progresses, each participant receives a number of free changes. Unused free changes carry forward to later stages.
rules.multiFinesPenaltyP1: Once your free changes are used up, you can still make changes to route predictions — but each change will cost a fine based on the current tournament stage. The further into the tournament, the higher the fine per change.
rules.multiResetP1: After the group stage and before the knockout stage begins, we will help you understand your situation by marking each of your predictions with a color indicating its scoring potential.
rules.multiResetP2: Each participant will receive a one-time offer to reset the entire bracket in exchange for a reduced fine, based on the state of their predictions (this will vary per person).
rules.multiResetNoteGreen: After a reset, all knockout edits are completely free - no fines, regardless of stage.
rules.multiResetNoteYellow: This does not affect the free changes you have accumulated up to this stage.
rules.availabilityP1: Each prediction type has an editing window. Once a stage begins or the deadline passes, it locks.
rules.availabilityNote: While knockout matches are active, ALL predictions are locked for editing.
rules.leaguesP1: You can compete with friends in leagues. There are 2 league types:
rules.tiebreakerSubtitle: Equal on points? Ranking is decided by:
rules.temptationBody:
The Temptation offer can help you increase your score if you believe in a surprise result.

Tap the button and you'll be offered 3 rare scoreline options (that almost nobody has predicted). You can choose one of them. If your prediction is correct (direction/exact score), your points will be doubled accordingly.
